description: This file defines a SwiftUI view for onboarding into a gateway connection, including UI components for auto-detecting or manually entering gateway details, handling user input, and managing connection states.

classes.name: GatewayOnboardingView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI View presenting onboarding options for connecting to a gateway.

classes.name: AutoDetectStep
classes.description: A private SwiftUI View managing auto-detection and auto-connection to gateways.

classes.name: ManualEntryStep
classes.description: A private SwiftUI View allowing manual input of gateway connection details.

classes.name: ConnectionStatusBox
classes.description: A SwiftUI View displaying connection status lines and secondary information.

methods.name: gatewayConnectionStatusLines
methods.description: Generates status lines for displaying current connection status details.

methods.name: resetGatewayConnectionState
methods.description: Resets gateway connection state and disconnects any active connection.

methods.name: gatewayConnectionStatusSection
methods.description: Builds a section displaying the connection status using ConnectionStatusBox.

methods.name: applySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes and applies a setup code, configuring gateway URL or host details, and saves relevant tokens.

methods.name: applyURL
methods.description: Parses a URL to populate manual gateway connection fields with proper TLS settings.
